All prescriptions use 25-metre pool lengths. Repetitions such as 15 FAST / 10 easy mean a full 25m length:
accelerate for approximately 15m, then finish easily.

A 25-yard repeat is shorter than 25m. Label all new yard totals as yards, and re-establish intervals from a
swimmer's actual training speed rather than copying metre send-offs.
A listed @1:30 is a send-off - start each repetition every 1 minute 30 seconds. If a swimmer cannot recover
or maintain intended technique, use additional rest or a longer interval.
